name: openpost
description: Official MCP server for OpenPost. Inspect connected accounts and media, draft and review social content, schedule or publish it, and manage comments where supported.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint with OAuth discovery. Sign in to OpenPost and authorize a workspace when prompted.

examples.title: Review the schedule
examples.description: Inspect upcoming social publications before they go live.
examples.prompt: Show me the publications scheduled for this week and flag anything that needs attention.

examples.title: Draft a publication
examples.description: Prepare content without publishing it immediately.
examples.prompt: Create a draft announcing our latest release for LinkedIn and Bluesky, adapted to each platform.

examples.title: Find the next slot
examples.description: Use the workspace schedule to find an available publishing time.
examples.prompt: Find the next available slot for this campaign and schedule the approved publication there.

examples.title: Check publication status
examples.description: Inspect lifecycle events and provider outcomes.
examples.prompt: Check whether yesterday's publication succeeded on every network and show me any failures.
